original_failed_attempt.source:
"""Preserve five unknown originals; retire only ended tools and verified duplicates."""

import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile

ROOT = Path("/workspaces/quoridor")
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OLD = ROOT / ".worktree/arena-evaluation"
OWN = (
    ROOT
    / ".worktree/search-optimization/.artifacts/worktree-retirement-v1/group-B/remaining-arena-v1/final-ten-v1"
)
PUBLIC = ROOT / "research-data/ai-sigma/execution324-worktree-retirement-20261021"
DEST = ROOT / ".worktree/assets/perf/retired-arena-evaluation/legacy349-unqualified-v1"


def run(argv):
    r = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=150)
    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stdout + r.stderr
    return r.stdout, r.stderr


def put(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")


def exact(path, sha):
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == sha
    return raw


def metadata(path):
    s = path.lstat()
    assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode)
    return dict(
        device=s.st_dev,
        inode=s.st_ino,
        bytes=s.st_size,
        mode=f"{stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode):04o}",
        mtime_ns=s.st_mtime_ns,
    )


def digest(path):
    result = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            result.update(block)
    return result.hexdigest()


def main():
    table = json.loads(
        exact(
            OWN / "final-ten-and-canonical-table.json",
            "f865341084b029269352aa7e69341f54695833dfcb7ec7f33232d5df11b2e600",
        )
    )
    stop = json.loads(
        exact(
            OWN / "returned-final-ten-STOP.json",
            "6d77941fdbff4ec7b77607f246ad8811cad8c30aec23648397a9e724cd3e8790",
        )
    )
    assert stop["directwait_reap_handles"] and not stop["TMP"] and not stop["leases"]
    relocation = json.loads((PUBLIC / "arena-original-body-relocation-v1.json").read_bytes())
    canonical = {r["original"]: r["canonical"] for r in relocation["actual"]["entries"]}
    selected = {r["original"]["path"] for r in table["legacy349"]}
    selected.update(r["original_image_FileRef"]["path"] for r in table["tools"])
    selected.update(r["redundant_original"] for r in table["canonical_aliases"])
    assert len(selected) == 15
    matches, denied = [], 0
    for proc in Path("/proc").iterdir():
        if not proc.name.isdigit():
            continue
        targets = [proc / "exe", proc / "cwd"]
        try:
            targets.extend((proc / "fd").iterdir())
        except PermissionError:
            denied += 1
        except FileNotFoundError:
            continue
        for target in targets:
            try:
                link = os.readlink(target).removesuffix(" (deleted)")
                if link in selected:
                    matches.append(dict(link=str(target), target=link))
            except PermissionError:
                denied += 1
            except OSError:
                pass
    assert not matches
    put(
        OUT / "process-check.json",
        dict(matches=matches, permission_denied=denied, all_host_STOP=False),
    )
    # Preserve exact source patches and recipes before removing ended non-comparison tools.
    patches, bodies = [], {}
    for n, tool in enumerate(table["tools"]):
        reconstruction = tool["reconstruction"]
        run(["git", "cat-file", "-e", reconstruction["source_commit"] + "^{commit}"])
        run(["git", "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", reconstruction["source_commit"], "HEAD"])
        assert not reconstruction["untracked_inputs"]
        ref = reconstruction["source_patch"]
        raw = exact(Path(ref["path"]), ref["sha256"])
        assert len(raw) == ref["bytes"]
        name = f"source-patches/{n}.patch"
        bodies[name] = raw
        patches.append(
            dict(original=ref, member=name, source_commit=reconstruction["source_commit"])
        )
    archive = PUBLIC / "arena-ended-tool-source-patches.tar.gz"
    assert not archive.exists()
    with tarfile.open(archive, "w:gz") as bundle:
        for row in patches:
            raw = bodies[row["member"]]
            info = tarfile.TarInfo(row["member"])
            info.size, info.mode = len(raw), 0o644
            bundle.addfile(info, io.BytesIO(raw))
    found = set()
    with tarfile.open(archive, "r|gz") as bundle:
        for info in bundle:
            with bundle.extractfile(info) as stream:
                assert stream.read() == bodies[info.name]
            assert info.mode == 0o644
            found.add(info.name)
    assert found == set(bodies)
    assert not DEST.exists() and OLD.stat().st_dev == DEST.parent.stat().st_dev
    legacy = []
    for row in table["legacy349"]:
        original = row["original"]
        p = Path(original["path"])
        before = metadata(p)
        assert before["bytes"] == original["bytes"] and before["mode"] == original["mode"]
        target = DEST / p.relative_to(OLD)
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        assert not target.exists()
        os.rename(p, target)
        assert metadata(target) == before and not p.exists()
        legacy.append(
            dict(
                original=str(p),
                canonical=str(target),
                before=before,
                after=metadata(target),
                sha256=None,
                scientific_qualification="UNKNOWN_UNQUALIFIED",
                body_read_hash_copy_execute=0,
            )
        )
        put(OUT / "legacy-progress.json", legacy)
    duplicates, cache = [], {}
    for row in table["canonical_aliases"]:
        p = Path(row["redundant_original"])
        keep = row["keep_canonical_original_FileRef"]
        target = Path(canonical.get(keep["path"], keep["path"]))
        before = metadata(p)
        assert before["bytes"] == row["bytes"] and before["mode"] == row["mode"]
        # Only this new deletion boundary: four aliases + their three retained bodies,
        # and one tiny public witness. No census/image qualification or execution.
        if str(target) not in cache:
            cache[str(target)] = digest(target)
        assert digest(p) == cache[str(target)] == row["saved_same_sha256"]
        assert metadata(p) == before
        p.unlink()
        duplicates.append(
            dict(
                original=str(p),
                retained=str(target),
                before=before,
                sha256=row["saved_same_sha256"],
                exact_current_duplicate=True,
            )
        )
        put(OUT / "duplicate-progress.json", duplicates)
    tools = []
    for tool in table["tools"]:
        ref = tool["original_image_FileRef"]
        p = Path(ref["path"])
        before = metadata(p)
        assert before["bytes"] == ref["bytes"] and before["mode"] == ref["mode"]
        assert tool["original_build_stop"]["cleanup_complete"]
        assert not tool["original_build_stop"]["remaining"]
        p.unlink()
        tools.append(
            dict(
                original=ref,
                before=before,
                disposition="Ended non-comparison generated tool; source commit and exact patch retained. No planned direct image comparison.",
                binary_bit_identical_rebuild="UNPROVEN_NOT_EXECUTED",
            )
        )
        put(OUT / "tool-progress.json", tools)
    report = PUBLIC / "arena-final-image-disposition-v1.json"
    put(
        report,
        dict(
            issue="quoridor-4lc.324.12.6",
            legacy_originals=legacy,
            duplicate_removals=duplicates,
            ended_tool_removals=tools,
            original_metadata_table=table,
            tool_source_patches=dict(
                path=str(archive.relative_to(ROOT)),
                sha256=digest(archive),
                bytes=archive.stat().st_size,
                members=patches,
                one_stream_reconstruction=True,
            ),
            process_check=json.loads((OUT / "process-check.json").read_bytes()),
            worker_returned_STOP=stop,
            original_RAW_and_failure_records_unchanged=True,
            old_costs_unknowns_preserved=True,
            old_and_new_body_allocation_not_added_twice=True,
            global_actual_fullfees="UNKNOWN",
            refund_lending=False,
            native_model_Search_training_replays=0,
            managed_worktree_removal="PENDING other coverage",
        ),
    )
    run(["tools/research-quality/node_modules/.bin/prettier", "--write", str(report)])
    run(["tools/research-quality/node_modules/.bin/prettier", "--check", str(report)])
    paths = [str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) for p in [report, archive]]
    put(OUT / "paths.json", paths)
    saved = run(
        [
            sys.executable,
            "-B",
            "scripts/dev/research-save.py",
            "save",
            "--paths-file",
            str(OUT / "paths.json"),
            "--issue",
            "quoridor-4lc.324.12.6",
            "--actor",
            "codex:01a1376a-bfd3-75d2-bd64-61e9416b3b13",
            "--message",
            "Finish bounded arena original-image disposition\n\nRetain five unqualified legacy bodies by same-inode relocation. Remove only five currently verified duplicates and five ended non-comparison generated tools, preserving exact source patches, recipes, failures and costs. No native execution or scientific requalification.",
            "--writers-stopped",
        ]
    )[0]
    (OUT / "save.stdout").write_text(saved)
    commit = json.loads(saved)["commit"]
    for name in paths:
        assert (
            subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", commit + ":" + name], cwd=ROOT)
            == (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
        )
    pushed = run(["git", "push", "origin", "main"])
    (OUT / "push.stdout").write_text(pushed[0])
    (OUT / "push.stderr").write_text(pushed[1])
    assert run(["git", "ls-remote", "origin", "refs/heads/main"])[0].split()[0] == commit
    assert not run(["git", "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"])[0]
    put(
        OUT / "push-result.json",
        dict(
            commit=commit,
            remote_main=commit,
            push_exit_code=0,
            legacy_moved=5,
            duplicates_removed=5,
            ended_tools_removed=5,
            remaining_dirty=[],
        ),
    )
    run(["bash", "scripts/dev/beads.sh", "backup", "sync"])
    print(json.dumps(dict(commit=commit, legacy=5, duplicates=5, ended_tools=5)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
